value.rationale: Population viability evaluated at a finite conservation or mutant-establishment horizon need not follow the ranking under long-run eventual extinction, even with identical expected reproductive fitness at every generation. The theorem gives an exact boundary on reproduction capacity and a complete qualitative classification plus checkable local criterion for all admissible cubic-law pairs, rather than an isolated numerical curiosity. It makes precise when mean reproductive performance is inadequate for time-horizon risk ranking.
